name: Orcus Figurine
description: Carved from an ogre's petrified heart, the gray figurine depicts the Demon Prince of Undeath in ghastly detail, clutching his skull-topped wand in one hand and three severed heads by the hair in the other. The figurine smells like decaying flesh, and this scent is detectable out to a range of 5 feet. The figurine is a Tiny object with AC 17, 3 hit points, and immunity to all types of damage except radiant damage.
